The '''''Aka'jor''-class shuttle''' was a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] model designed and built by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] company, [[MandalMotors/Legends|MandalMotors]]. The shuttle was lauded for the efficiency of its [[Engine/Legends|engines]] and the smooth acceleration they provided, contributing to its popularity. Just under eighteen [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length, the ''Aka'jor''-class shuttle was constructed without weapons, but was easily modified with additional armament by customers interested in owning an assault craft rather than a peaceful transport.

Though the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] found numerous buyers throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the ''Aka'jor''-class shuttle found significant use among the pacifistic [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] faction. The New Mandalorians' leader, [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]], made use of an ''Akajor'' shuttle to transport herself and the visiting [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] from the New Mandalorians' [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]], to [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Concordia/Legends|Concordia]]. A [[Unidentified New Mandalorian scout/Legends|member]] of the New [[Mandalorian Guard/Legends|Mandalorian police]] later utilized an ''Aka'jor''-class shuttle while spying on the renegade Mandalorians group known as the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], at their [[Death Watch hideout|secret base]] on Concordia.

==Characteristics==
[[File:Mandalorian_shuttle2.png|thumb|left|150px|An ''Aka'jor''-class shuttle in landing configuration]]
The ''Aka'jor''-class [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] was 17.97 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length. Manufactured by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] corporation, [[MandalMotors/Legends|MandalMotors]], the shuttle featured twin rotating wings that were held in a horizontal layout while flying, but swung into an upward configuration for landing. This feature was one shared by MandalMotors' [[Kom'rk-class fighter/transport/Legends|''Kom'rk''-class fighter/transport]], but unlike the ''Kom'rk'', the standard ''Aka'jor''-class shuttle was built without any manner of armament. However, the shuttle was receptive to custom modifications, and a number of MandalMotors customers transformed the shuttle into attack craft with aftermarket weaponry. Crewed by a sparse two individuals,<ref name="TCWIV" /> including a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], from a forward-positioned [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]]<ref name="TMP" /> the speedy vessel possessed two wing-mounted [[Engine/Legends|engines]] for propulsion, whose efficiency contributed to a praised smoothness of acceleration. At the shuttle's rear, an aft [[Turbolift/Legends|lift]] was responsible for the boarding of passengers and the loading of cargo.<ref name="TCWIV" />

==Role==
The unarmed ''Aka'jor'' was most prominently a shuttle, in line with its official MandalMotors designation.<ref name="TCWIV" /> Capable of entering and exiting a [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], a number of ''Aka'jor''-class shuttles were used by the New Mandalorian faction for [[Transport/Legends|transport]] back and forth between [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] and [[Concordia/Legends|Concordia]],<ref name="TMP" /> one of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world's two [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Other customers elected to modify their ''Aka'jor''-class shuttles, adding non-standard weaponry to the vehicle, and transforming them into customized assault craft.<ref name="TCWIV" />

==History==
Designed by MandalMotors<ref name="TCWIV" />—a prominent Mandalorian starship company and driving force behind the planet Mandalore's economy,<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> headquartered in the planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of Keldabe—<ref name="TEA" />the ''Aka'jor''-class shuttle was put into production at a point in [[Time/Legends|time]] prior to the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|start]] of the [[The galaxy/Legends|pan-galactic]] [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. A large number of MandalMotors clients purchased ''Aka'jor''-class shuttles, and the Mandalorian vessel soon gained a reputation for its efficient engines and smooth acceleration. Many of these buyers took to customizing their shuttles with aftermarket weaponry, forming modified attack craft from the standard unarmed vehicle.<ref name="TCWIV" />

[[File:AkajorClassShuttle-DuchessOfMandalore.jpg|thumb|right|250px|An ''Aka'jor''-class shuttle touching down in Sundari]]
A number of standard, unarmed ''Aka'jor''-class shuttles<ref name="TCWIV" /> entered into the possession of the pacifist Mandalorian faction calling themselves the New Mandalorians.<ref name="TMP" /><ref name="TEA" /> Several could be found at the docks of the New Mandalorian [[Domed city/Legends|domed]] capital, [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]],<ref name="TMP" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the second year of the Clone Wars.<ref name="Star Wars Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> That same year, when the [[Memorial Shrine/Legends|Memorial Shrine]] at the heart of Sundari was [[Attack on the Memorial Shrine/Legends|bombed]] and [[Death Watch bomber/Legends|the perpetrator]] took his own life, the New Mandalorians' leader, [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] traveled with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]—who was on Mandalore investigating rumors of Mandalorian [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorism]]—aboard an ''Aka'jor''-class shuttle to return the [[Death/Legends|dead]] [[Gender/Legends|man's]] body to Mandalore's moon, Concordia, where he was from. There, Kryze and Kenobi discovered the [[Death Watch hideout|hidden base]] of the Mandalorian splinter-group, [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]].<ref name="TMP" /> Not long after, a [[Unidentified New Mandalorian scout/Legends|member]] of the New [[Mandalorian Guard/Legends|Mandalorian police]] [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|force]] used an ''Aka'jor''-class shuttle while [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] the Death Watch's base in the Concordian<ref name="DoM">{{TCW|Duchess of Mandalore}}</ref> [[Beskar/Legends|''beskar'']] [[Concordian mines/Legends|mines]].<ref name="NewBattlefronts">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: New Battlefronts: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> Piloting the ''Aka'jor'' shuttle back to Sundari from Mandalore's moon, the scout reported his findings on the amassing Death Watch [[Army/Legends|army]] to the New Mandalorian [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]], [[Almec/Legends|Almec]].<ref name="DoM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Aka'jor''-class shuttle first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series' [[Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] episode, ''[[The Mandalore Plot]]'', which originally aired [[January 29]], [[2010]]. It later appeared in the following episodes, ''[[Duchess of Mandalore]]'', ''[[Corruption (episode)|Corruption]]'', and ''[[The Academy]]'', all of which featured the New Mandalorians. Statistical information on the vehicle was later provided through the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]'' guide book, published in [[2011]], which finally gave the shuttle its name.

The name ''Aka'jor'' appears to come from the Mandalorian [[Language/Legends|language]] of [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']], developed by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]], specifically the words ''aka'', meaning "mission", and ''jorir'', meaning "carry".<ref name="Mando'a">{{WebCite|url=http://www.karentraviss.com/page20/page26/index.html|text=Mando'a|author=Karen Traviss|work=[http://www.karentraviss.com Karen Traviss]|archivedate=20110925083955}}</ref>

The shuttle also made a background appearance in the now-closed online game, [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures]]. This variant appeared to be equipped with weapons towards the front of the ship.
